topography.project_purpose: Yield. Structurally: 12 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 2 ERC20 tokens, 3 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 10 common project-authored base contract(s) (authentication, signaturesafeguard, eoasignaturesvalidator). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
